content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for PTU Registrar Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://ptuniv.edu.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 31-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Puducherry Technological University (PTU) for the Registrar position under advertisement number PTU/REG/RECRUITMENT/2026/1087 located in Puducherry.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under PTU Registrar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the post of Registrar at Puducherry Technological University on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for PTU Registrar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form along with required documents is 31-10-2026. Candidates must ensure timely submission.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for PTU Registrar posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is completely offline. Candidates need to download the form and send the hard copy to the university address.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Registrar post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Registrar position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 1.44,200 Per Month under Level 14 pay structure.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are required to apply for the Registrar post?
faq.answer: Applicants must possess a Master’s Degree with at least 55% marks or equivalent grade, along with experience as a Professor or Administrator in the rank of Professor with at least three years of administrative experience.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for PTU Registrar Recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, an application fee of Rs.1000/- is applicable for General, OBC, SC, and ST category candidates as specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for PTU Registrar jobs?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises selection on a tenure basis, a personal interview, and thorough document verification of the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification PDF by visiting the Important Links section in this article and clicking on the provided download link.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of Puducherry Technological University?
faq.answer: The official website of Puducherry Technological University to access notifications, updates, and application details is https://ptuniv.edu.in.
